Перейдите в каталог `~/cpu-topology`.

:::{#exr-lab-libvirt-cpu-scheduling-cpu-topology-baseline}
#### Сбор CPU topology и baseline

Сохраните вывод команд:

```bash
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system nodeinfo > nodeinfo.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system capabilities > capabilities.xml
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vcpucount lab-vm > vcpucount.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system vcpuinfo lab-vm > vcpuinfo.txt
sudo -n virsh -c qemu:///system cpu-stats lab-vm --total > cpu-stats-total.txt
```
:::
